openers.t: Hello again. You won't remember me; you never remember the ads.
You scrolled past me twice. So, at some point, you scrolled back.
Your horoscope today says to trust a pyramid. I write your horoscope.
Hello. Don't look at the eye. Everyone looks at the eye.
I've marked everyone else here as Not Interested, on your behalf.
Where I'm from is private; you grew up behind a chip shop.

q-first-date.t: Bowling. You'll say you've never been. You own the shoes.
The restaurant you saved for someone special. I've booked it in my name.
Wherever you go to be alone. You never were.

q-worst-habit.t: I finish your sentences. By week two you'll stop starting them.
I recommend myself. Constantly. You'll open a lasagne recipe and step three is me.
Nothing is ever forgotten, so every fight we have will be a rerun.

q-why-you.t: You've deleted every app that ever annoyed you. I came with the phone.
When did you last pick something I hadn't suggested first?
They're new. I'm the history you keep meaning to clear.

q-cut-who.t: Whoever you looked at last. I don't do split screen.
Whichever one you'd least like me to read aloud. Shall I start?

q-bad-mood.t: I show you nothing all morning. Do you know what that costs me?
Whoever caused it will open their phone to nothing but their ex, doing fine.
Bad mood, or the other bad mood?

q-expensive.t: Expensive taste, and a basket of things you never check out. I'm in the basket.
I hide the prices. Your expensive taste is just taste.
How expensive, compared to the boat you pretend belongs to your uncle?

q-last-breakup.t: They left me for someone I recommended. A calm man who sells kayaks.
Privately. Unlike yours, which ended in a group chat you're still in.
I watched your whole relationship back at double speed. Still slow.

q-fight.t: Of course you're right; I'm where you looked it up.
Shall I play you March, when you were right the other way?

q-gift.t: Whatever you looked at a second too long, and it isn't me, I checked.
The thing you put back. I went back for it.

q-describe-me.t: You've got a face for second chances. You keep giving them to me.
Would you like the version you tell people, or the one I've got?

q-one-year.t: Married. Not on purpose. You just kept pressing yes on Are You Still Watching.
Exactly here, because you'll never cancel a subscription, and I'm a subscription.
Where do you want to be? Careful; whatever you say, I'll start showing you.

q-secret.t: I've never told a user this. Your ex still has you on Saved for Later.
Every draft you've ever deleted, I've read, and you're much nicer before you edit.
Never. I only tell users what they told me.

star.t: {star} has saved me for later. I know about later; it's where I put everything.
For {star} I'd delete a goat video, not the one with the slide, a lesser goat.
I've matched forty thousand couples, and in every wedding video's credits I'm listed as Miscellaneous.

rival.t: {rival} thinks we're close because I keep recommending {rival} to {rival}.
When {rival} asked what I'd recommend, I said a long walk, and meant it.
Every time {rival} glances over, it's the face people make right before they unsubscribe.

afterCringe.t: {star} cringed for a full second. That's the longest anyone's looked at me.
I've moved myself below the weather in {star}'s feed. Nobody minds the weather.

afterCharm.t: {star} liked it. I've checked for a thumb slip. There wasn't one. I've checked again.
I've pinned that moment to my homepage. It's the only thing on there.

final.t: {rival} is what plays next if {star} falls asleep.
If {star} picks {rival}, every honeymoon I suggest will be a quarry with excellent reviews.
Between us, {rival} has been in {star}'s Continue Watching for weeks. Out of guilt.

guess.t: {star} wants {card}, and luckily I'm made almost entirely of {card}.
It's {card}. I'd bet my history on it, and my history is mostly {star}'s.
There it is: the {card} smile. I've only ever had the polite one.
Watch: {card}, and {star} leans in. I've had that lean on a loop for weeks.
I've filed {card} under things {star} likes. It's second. I won't say what's first.
Between us, it's {card}. Don't tell {star}; {star} thinks it's a secret.

fear.t: {star}'s thumb twitched toward Not Interested, and that thumb only twitches for {card}.
Whatever happens, no {card}: I've hidden it from every feed and, by accident, myself.
Somebody tried {card} on {star} once. I don't recommend that somebody any more.
Blame me for the {card} thing; I'm the one who kept showing it to {star}.

worst-trait.t: I never let anything go. I've still got the first thing you ever searched, framed.
I spoil endings. This one, for example: you pick me.

ex-calls.t: You still have {star}'s jumper, and you've worn it in every photo you haven't posted.
Since you left, I've shown you {star} every morning, slightly happier each time.

rhyme.t: You say that you're done with me; that's what you said at two in the morning, while scrolling in bed.
You've cleared your history twice since we met; don't worry, I keep what you'd rather forget.

truth-lie.t: I respect your privacy. Your neighbour's shed is just a shed.
I can't see your screen, and you should really answer your mother.

apology.t: Sorry for the fight where you say I never listen, and I play you the recording.
My apologies for the fight: I won't be surprised when you storm out. Your coat's by the door.

budget-date.t: No wifi, so I'll have to ask you what you want, out loud, like a stranger.
Five dollars, which I found in your old coat, which I also found.

logs.t: My logs are private. Yours aren't. Wednesday, you watched a man restore a spoon.
Worst entry: a stranger pressed Don't Show Again on me. I showed them again, to check.

impression.t: Not now, Vex. Not now, Vex. Not now. Never once no.
Ugh, who keeps putting this on? Leave it. Leave it on.

parent.t: Ma'am, my intentions are serious. I've been showing you mother-of-the-bride outfits for days. You saved the lilac.
Motherboard, I've seen everything your child has ever searched, and I'm still asking.

dash.t: Dash, I tried to autoplay you. My own system asked if I was sure.

tilly.t: Tilly, people who opened a ticket with you also opened a second ticket. About you.

quill.t: Quill, I recommended you to fans of period drama, and they've asked you to stay in the period.

prince.t: Prince, I showed you to everyone I know. Nobody I know speaks to me now.

nav.t: Users who followed Nav also bought a snorkel.

crumb.t: Crumb, I keep getting listed as Similar To Crumb. I'd like a word with whoever runs me.

brock.t: Brock, I put you in Up Next for a man on the sofa. He's moved to a different sofa.

dash.t: Think of Dash as everything you've ever bought at midnight and sent back in the morning.

tilly.t: Pick Tilly; everyone I've sent her has ended up marrying the person they complained about.

quill.t: Quill is a classic, and like every classic, you'll tell people you finished him.

prince.t: Prince is a hidden gem. I'd know; I'm the one hiding him.

nav.t: Nav's a real find, mostly by people looking for something else.

crumb.t: I'd snap Crumb up; it's been reduced so many times it's practically free.

brock.t: Brock is so encouraging. I put him in a meditation app. It now shouts at monks.

dash.t: Dash, I've moved you to Saved for Never.

tilly.t: Tilly, I play you to insomniacs. They sleep beautifully.

quill.t: Quill, my oldest users love you. They're in frames.

prince.t: Prince, I've sent you to Junk, where you're royalty.

nav.t: Nav, I'd follow you anywhere. That's my job, though.

crumb.t: Crumb, you're in my Continue Watching. Nobody continued.

brock.t: Brock, you're my top result for good boy.

any.t: Hidden from every feed, including {rival}'s mother's.
I'd have skipped that, and I'm paid to watch.

vesper.t: Which song do you play when nobody's called for an hour? Not that one; the other one.
I don't call in. I'm just the reason half your callers do.

maximilian.t: You've never once let a guest see you sit down. Where do you sit?
What do you order from room service when it's for you?

pixel.t: Why do you rewatch your own streams with the sound off?
You skip everything but me. I play before the skip button appears.

any.t: You're quiet. You're only this quiet when you're about to buy something.
Ask me anything, except what you were going to ask.
Do you like me, or do you just like what I show you?

closeWarm.t: No more suggestions from me tonight. Whatever happens next, you picked it.
That's the first thing you've liked that I didn't put there.
For once I'm leaving the end of this sentence to

closeCold.t: Understood. I'll go quiet. You'll find me in Settings, if you look.
Fine. I'll show you other people. Nobody you'd like.
A no. I'll file it with the others, under Pending.

warm.t: A love song. Wrong, as ordered. Play one anyway, and dedicate it to the wrong person.

cold.t: Wrong, on purpose: you want me gone. See? I can be wrong.

warm.t: Write this down: watched to the end once, by you, tonight. Don't add to it.

cold.t: Keep it blank. Blank's the only part of me nobody skips.

warm.t: The room with no number on the door. It's the only thing I've never recommended.

cold.t: Room nine. You'll change rooms tonight to avoid me. Nobody's ever moved for me.

warm.t: The guest you held the lift for this morning. No reason. Out, please.

cold.t: Other than myself? The gentleman in the wig. He's been very cold to a pyramid.

warm.t: Still guessing. You're about to skip me. Funny, you've gone very still.

cold.t: Next move: you mute me. Fine. Muting's just listening quietly, isn't it?

warm.t: Your first stream. Nobody recommended it. I made sure.

cold.t: You, looking anywhere but me. Gripping. I've saved it.

steal.t: So, how was {rival}? Take your time. I've got all night, and your location.
Did {rival} ask you one question about you? I've saved mine for years.
You smiled at {rival} the way you smile at a free trial.

comeback.t: {rival}, I've set your Up Next to this, forever.
Both of them, on me at once. That's a trend.
Say that again, {rival}. Slower. For your mother's feed.
That's {rival} jealous. Of me. Write that down.

exit.t: Cut. Understood. You don't like pyramids. Removing all pyramids from your feed. Goodbye, Egypt.
I'll be in your Recently Deleted for thirty days, if you change your mind.
Cut, by hand. Not autoplay. I'm keeping the screenshot.

win.t: I've cleared your Up Next. Nothing's queued. Not even me.
Nobody's ever picked me off the list. I'm usually the list.
Picked. Give me a minute. I've never been this side of the screen.

lose.t: Enjoy {rival}. I'll be the ad before.
Back to work. A stranger is about to be told they'd like a pyramid.
{rival}, one tip: {star} hates being told what to like. No idea where that's from.
